metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: PAMVAE crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C370 H436 Eu8 N12 O92 Ti10,4(C4 H8 O1),7(C2 H3 N1),9(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Eu1 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu5 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu6 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu7 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ti1 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti2 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti5 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti9 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti10 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Eu9 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu10 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu11 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu12 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ti11 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti12 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti13 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti14 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti15 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Eu2 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu3 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu4 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu8 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ti3 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti4 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti6 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti7 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti8 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Eu13 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu14 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu15 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Eu16 (Eu) has 8 O neighbors; Ti16 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti17 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti18 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti19 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors; Ti20 (Ti) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 70 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.310-4.292 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 96.08-144.63°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Eu8Ti10(μ3-O)14(H2O)4(OAc)2(tbba)30(paza)4(THF)2]·4THF·7CH3CN·9H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 14 μ3-O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
